name: dsmnru-pyq-android
description: Native-feeling DSMNRU PYQ Android app: a dedicated mobile-first UI (bottom navigation, app-designed home/search/courses/saved/profile/paper screens) bundled inside the APK, talking directly to the existing Cloudflare Worker API and the existing Firebase Auth project. It is NOT a WebView copy of the website and adds no second backend.
author: DSMNRU Academic Archive

scripts.build:debug: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
